# Vendor Onboarding

New vendors go through a security and procurement review before a contract is signed.

## Security review

Every vendor completes a security questionnaire. Vendors that process personal data must also provide a SOC 2 Type II report that is less than 12 months old.

## Procurement

The Driftfin procurement desk owns the review and keeps the vendor register up to date. Contracts above 50,000 US dollars per year require approval from the chief financial officer.

## Renewal

Vendors are reassessed every year before renewal.
